Md Moazzam Hossain with Md Hasmatullah Sheikh Advocates ----- For the Appellant.

parties:
Asadul Hoque, Trading as Samrat Shoe ------ Appellant 
vs
Registrar of Trade Marks & another ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 8. For the discussions made above, we hold that the application filed by the learned Advocate for the respondent on 15-2-97 on plain paper to the Registrar of Trade Marks with the prayer to issue renewal certificate rejecting the deed of assignment was not maintainable in law and the Registrar acted illegally in entertaining the same and then in passing the impugned order cancelling the entry made in the register as to the change of proprietorship of the trade mark in question. However, there being no limitation in filing application under section 46 of the Act, read with rule 65 of the Revised Trade Marks Rules, 1963, if so advised, the petitioner may file application under TM 26 for expunging or varying the entry made in the register. And if so filed, the Registrar shall dispose of the same in accordance with law.
